rules.requirement: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)

assertingTests.name: Scarlet Woman inherits only with five living before the Demon dies (TB-SCARLETWOMAN-01)
a registered-dead player does not count toward the Scarlet Woman's five (TB-SCARLETWOMAN-01)

rules.requirement: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)

assertingTests.name: the new Demon is woken the night after a daytime Scarlet Woman succession (TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
a Scarlet Woman who takes the role by day after a night self-kill is woken the next night, once (TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
a Demon who died on an earlier day does not make a later night change wake twice (TB-IMP-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
a journal recorded while the new Demon was woken twice replays and undoes as written (TB-IMP-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
